rationale: Network FiberCo, LLC is a distinct U.S. wholesale-fiber platform rather than Ziply Fiber's acquisition holdco or acquisition debt. The joint venture completed on August 1, 2025, with PSP Investments holding 51% through PSPIB Quadratic Blocker, LLC and BCE/Ziply holding 49% through Northwest Fiber, LLC. Its subsidiaries own and build fiber while Ziply is the exclusive retail ISP and operator.
recommendedChanges: Create one canonical Network FiberCo, LLC company.
Record PSP Investments as an active 51% owner through PSPIB Quadratic Blocker, LLC from August 1, 2025.
Record BCE/Ziply Fiber as an active 49% owner through Northwest Fiber, LLC from August 1, 2025.
Treat HICI as PSP's disclosed investment portfolio/strategy attribution, not as a separately proven legal fund entity.
Roll up NFC Management and NFC Northwest as subsidiaries; retain Ziply Fiber as a separate BCE-owned operating platform and do not map PSP's 51% Network FiberCo interest to Ziply.
unresolvedQuestions: Actual cumulative member equity and any closed non-recourse debt are not publicly disclosed.
Board, veto, reserved-matter and transfer terms are not publicly disclosed.
Asset-by-asset timing of Ziply network contributions and PSP's former Ziply stake/vehicle are not publicly disclosed.
